title: Deaths with Alzheimer’s disease or dementia as the underlying cause, United States, 2022 to 2024 (CDC NCHS)
summary: Death records with an underlying cause of Alzheimer’s disease (G30), vascular dementia (F01) or unspecified dementia (F03): 234,649 in 2022, 223,553 in 2023 and 224,680 in 2024.

provenance.source_type: Federal death records (NCHS public-use mortality files), counted by script
provenance.origin: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) public-use mortality files for 2022, 2023 and 2024 (death records)
provenance.reliability: Counts of records by underlying cause. The code positions in the file were checked only by whether the counts look plausible, not against the official record layout.

limits: Death records, not people living with dementia.
Only the underlying cause is counted, so deaths where dementia was a contributing cause are missed.
The record-layout check against the official NCHS layout has not been done; 2016 to 2021 were not read.
Not about caregivers, and not from the paper’s sample.
note: Context only. Not an input to any simulator and not computed by an AI model.
